subject: Coordinating demo across US / EU / APAC — proposed split plan
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Anna Müller <anna.muller@eurotech.de>, Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@nipponcloud.jp>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed times for product demo — aligning US/EU/APAC windows

Hi Anna and Kenji,

Thanks again for the interest — excited to demo Redwood inference for EuroTech and NipponCloud. Given exec availability on both sides and the cross-region nature, I wanted to propose a few windows that try to minimize painful late-night times. Note that we’re currently on PDT (US), CEST (EU), and JST (APAC) — DST offsets are still in play so I spelled out local times below.

Option A (single live session) — 45m demo + 15m exec Q&A:
- 08:00 PDT / 17:00 CEST / 00:00 JST (next day)
- 10:00 PDT / 19:00 CEST / 02:00 JST (next day)

Option B (single live, later APAC-friendly):
- 16:00 PDT / 01:00 CEST (next day) / 09:00 JST (next day) — (this is not ideal for EU)

Option C (split approach — my recommendation):
- Live session for US + EU: 15:00 CEST / 06:00 PDT (45m demo + 15m Q&A)
- Short executive follow-up for APAC (recorded full demo + 20m exec sync): 21:00 JST (same day)

Attachments: proposed_calendar.ics (contains all candidate blocks)

Can you both confirm availability for any of the above or suggest concrete windows? If we need to loop execs directly, please include their availability for a 20–30m slot.

Thanks — I’ll hold time provisionally once we agree.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Anna Müller <anna.muller@eurotech.de>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T17:34:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Proposed times for product demo — aligning US/EU/APAC windows

Hi Neha,

Thanks — appreciate the clarity on offsets. Option A times are rough for us because anything at/after 19:00 CEST starts pushing into the team dinner window. Of the slots you listed, 15:00 CEST would be the clearest for EU product + procurement folks (that’s 06:00 PDT, 21:00 JST).

If the APAC exec can’t do 21:00 JST, we’d be fine with the split approach (Option C): EU + US live at 15:00 CEST, and a separate APAC exec sync. I’ve tentatively dropped a placeholder on my calendar for 15:00 CEST — link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=eu_demo_placeholder

Also — FYI, our VP Ops (Michael Hart) will want to sit in for the procurement section. Copying him in for availability.

Best,
Anna
Head of Platform Partnerships | EuroTech GmbH
anna.muller@eurotech.de
From: Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@nipponcloud.jp>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Anna Müller <anna.muller@eurotech.de>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T08:03:00+09:00
Subject: Re: Proposed times for product demo — aligning US/EU/APAC windows

Hi all,

Thanks for proposing multiple options. Unfortunately anything past 22:30 JST is rough for our exec (they typically finish calls by 21:30). The 21:00 JST slot is borderline but could work if we keep it tight and focused (20–30m).

To be concrete:
- I cannot do 00:00–03:00 JST (that’s too late).
- APAC exec available windows this week: 20:30–21:30 JST (best), or 08:00–09:00 JST (early morning).

If we do the split approach, please record the full demo and share a 15–20m highlight for execs so they don’t need to watch the whole replay.

Thanks,
Kenji Sato
Solutions Director | NipponCloud
kenji.sato@nipponcloud.jp
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Anna Müller <anna.muller@eurotech.de>, Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@nipponcloud.jp>
Date: 2026-05-11T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed times for product demo — aligning US/EU/APAC windows

Thanks for the updates — cc’ing Marissa for calendar ops. Quick suggested path to avoid forcing anyone into 2–3am slots:

Proposal (final):
- Live demo: 15:00 CEST / 06:00 PDT (45m demo + 15m product Q&A) — EU & US primary attendees
- APAC exec sync: 20:30–21:00 JST (short executive call) — replay + highlights recorded immediately after the live session and played/linked for APAC attendees in advance

Why this works:
- 06:00 PDT is early but within reason for US execs on the west coast (we can offer an alternative 08:00 PDT slot for east coast teammates if needed)
- EU gets a friendly afternoon slot
- APAC execs get an evening slot that’s within Kenji’s stated windows

Action items:
- I’ll attach a quick .ics with both blocks (proposed_calendar.ics) and Marissa can push updated invites once we lock times.
- Neha, can you confirm if the demo can be recorded and if we can produce a 15–20m highlight cut within 24 hours?

-Rishi
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference

- Confirmed: EU live at 15:00 CEST (we’ll have product, procurement, and a couple of engineers).
- APAC exec: 20:30–21:00 JST for the short sync. Kenji, please confirm final exec attendee list for that short block.
- Recording: please record the full session and do a 15–20m highlight for execs.

Also, small request — could you add a short scheduling matrix to the invite? We had a bit of confusion (DST conversions) on our side. Here’s a quick doc I use: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1scheduling_matrix and a WorldTimeBuddy reference: https://worldtimebuddy.com/?pl=1

Once invites are updated, please send updated calendar items and I’ll approve on my side.

Thanks,
Anna
